description_en: Creates tags and adds the tags to Elastic Block Storage (EBS) resources

kebab_example: aliyun ebs tag-resources --resource-id pair-cn-c4d2t7f0000 --tag Value=tag-value Key=tag-key --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type diskreplicagroup --client-token 0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe630000 --region cn-hangzhou
